description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be deprecated.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 地域ID，传入本参数来指定实例所在地域，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The region ID. Specify this parameter to indicate the region where the instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh:
指定同步方向，取值：
- **Forward**：正向。
- **Reverse**：反向。

> - 默认取值为**Forward**。
- 只有当数据同步实例的同步拓扑为双向同步时，才需要传入本参数。
description.en:
The synchronization direction. Valid values:

- **Forward**: forward.
- **Reverse**: reverse.

> - Default value: **Forward**.
- You need to specify this parameter only if the synchronization topology of the data synchronization instance is two-way synchronization.

description.zh: 数据同步实例ID，可以通过调用[DescribeSynchronizationJobs](~~49454~~)接口查询。
description.en: The ID of the data synchronization instance. You can call the [DescribeSynchronizationJobs](~~49454~~) operation to query the instance ID.

title.en: Retrieve current image matching switch configuration
